'''Creamed Rishi corn soup''' was served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] sold the [[Soup/Legends|soup]] on [[Zhellday/Legends|Zhelldays]] as part of its daily [[Pantoran Plate Specials]] for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The soup was made with [[Rishi corn/Legends|Rishi corn]]<ref name="Menu" /> and shared its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Creamed Rishi corn soup was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
